[Ermittlungsakte Nr. 1311 · Evidence Card · Excel for the web]{.kicker}

# The Corrupted Episode List

[Work in **your copy** of the evidence. Every formula is on the `Formulas` sheet. Fell behind? Switch to the `Catch_Up` tab named on screen and keep going.]{.sub}
:::

::: {.howto}
**Copying a formula:** click the green cell in `Formulas` → click in the formula bar → **Ctrl/⌘ + A**, **Ctrl/⌘ + C** → **Esc**. Type the new column name in the first empty header cell to the right of your table → **Enter** → click the cell below it → **Ctrl/⌘ + V** → **Enter**.
:::

::: {.grid}
